purpose: Follow-up on broad exact-name sweep entries involving Pierre Deligne, especially to prevent diagram/OCR/source-witness packages from being mistaken for polished paper translations or complete Deligne coverage.

public_records_checked.current_status_note: The repo already records the 2026-06-09 v3 update-bundle slot with D001-D017 witness pass, D001-D017 equation-dense audit, D074-D090 actual triage, and D074-D090 math-audit repairpass1.

decisions.decision: Keep as diagram/OCR/source-witness support unless manually curated and promoted. Most exact-name misses are geometry/diagram witnesses, corrective diagram witnesses, OCR mirrors, or crop/locator packages. They help detect omissions and diagram trouble but can contain false positives and are not reader editions.

Treat as working/paper-level Deligne material already conceptually covered by the v3 public-bundle language and current status caveats. The D017_GL2 p051 complete sequence has real FR/EN TeX/PDF/source/IDX structure, but local 'complete' labels are package-scope, not global Deligne certification.

Mostly update bundles, D074-D090 triage/math-fix variants, and a delete-me strict sample. The v3 update bundle is already described in public status; test/delete-me and intermediate variants should not be uploaded as reader surfaces.

representative_inspections.inspection: Contains D001_D017_witness_pass_complete_seqcum.zip, D001_D017_equation_dense_math_audit_seqcum.zip, D074_090dn_actualtriage4.zip, and D074_090dn_mathaudit_repairpass1.zip. README says working translation/repair/audit material, not final critical editions, and warns diagram-heavy/equation-dense passages must be checked against source witnesses.

Contains D017 GL2 paper-local current p051 material plus a sequential cumulative D001-D017 structure with FR/EN PDFs/TeX/scans/IDX and method ledgers. Internal format scan says D017 source_pages=51, d017_cum_en_pages=33, d017_cum_fr_pages=34. Useful paper-level package, not global Deligne completion.

Contains a large D077-D090 geometry aid layer with 500dpi labelled crops, context images, and ledgers. README says not yet certified diagram-only package and flags inherited false positives such as prose/header or handwritten list regions.

OCR/Surya witness mirror for papers 56-81, 83-85, and 87-89; papers 82 and 86 absent. README says locator and omission-checking aid only, not promoted TeX, reader PDF, translation, or source-faithful transcription.

public_facing_caveats_to_keep: Deligne is mixed and paper-by-paper, not globally complete.
D001-D017 and D074-D090/letters contain useful working material and source witnesses, but polish varies sharply by paper and object type.
Commutative diagrams and geometry displays must be rebuilt/source-checked before promotion; OCR/geometry witness packages can have false positives.
Do not upload test/delete-me or raw aid packages as if they were reader surfaces.
next_actions: No new Deligne upload is implied by this exact-name sweep slice.
If refreshing the Deligne record, prefer a curated v4/v-next rollup with explicit paper-range status and diagram/geometry caveats rather than dozens of witness-aid ZIPs.
Keep OCR witness mirrors as source-intake/workflow support only unless a later source-audited TeX/PDF package consumes them.
